title: Declaring a two-input gate
description: You can read a VHDL entity and its behavioral assignment.

steps.description: You import std_logic and declare and2. Its interface has two inputs, a and b, and one output, z.
The architecture gives the entity a behavioral implementation. The comment introduces the assignment that follows.

steps.question: For binary inputs a equal to one and b equal to zero, what does the AND expression produce?
steps.answer: It produces zero because both inputs must be one for the expression to produce one.

steps.description: You assign a and b to z with a concurrent signal assignment. The recorded output confirms analysis without errors and states that this block has no testbench simulation.
